title: Clinking Curio Cuttlefish
statement: Amid mossy sunken arches and twilight-blue water, this pint-sized cephalopod spends its days meticulously stacking tumbled sea glass and pearlescent shells into delicate, chiming towers. Whenever a visitor leans close, its velvet skin ripples with constellations of warm amber light as it proudly holds up its favorite shiny pebble for inspection.
